name: C states
description_fr: Active/désactive la gestion des C-states CPU, donc les états de repos.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable CPU Power Management. Allows CPU to go to C states when it's not 100% utilized.

name: Enhanced C-states
description_fr: Contrôle C1E : baisse la fréquence quand tous les cœurs sont en C-state.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable C1E. When enabled, CPU will switch to minimum speed when all cores enter C-State.

name: Turbo Mode
description_fr: Active/désactive le Turbo Boost du processeur.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable processor Turbo Mode.

name: Power Limit 1
description_fr: Définit PL1 (puissance soutenue) en milliwatts ; 0 demande la valeur TDP/base par défaut.
ifr_help: Power Limit 1 in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. 0 = no custom override. For 12.50W, enter 12500. Overclocking SKU: Value must be between Max and Min Power Limits. Other SKUs: This value must be between Min Power Limit and Processor Base Power (TDP) Limit. If value is 0, BIOS will program Processor Base Power (TDP) value.

name: Power Limit 1 Override
description_fr: Autorise le remplacement de PL1 par une valeur personnalisée au lieu de la politique BIOS par défaut.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Power Limit 1 override. If this option is disabled, BIOS will program the default values for Power Limit 1 and Power Limit 1 Time Window.

name: Power Limit 3 Override
description_fr: Autorise le remplacement de PL3 par les paramètres personnalisés ci-dessous.
ifr_help: Enable/DisablePower Limit 3 override. If this option is disabled, BIOS will leave the hardware default values for Power Limit 3 and Power Limit 3 Time Window.

name: Power Limit 3
description_fr: Définit PL3 en milliwatts, limite de puissance intermédiaire/plateforme.
ifr_help: Power Limit 3 in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. For 12.50W, enter 12500. XE SKU: Any value can be programmed. Overclocking SKU: Value must be between Max and Min Power Limits. Other SKUs: This value must be between Min Power Limit and Processor Base Power (TDP) Limit. If the value is 0, BIOS leaves the hardware default value

name: Power Limit 3 Time Window
parameters: 0 Auto/default; valeurs IFR discrètes jusqu'à 64 s
description_fr: Définit la fenêtre temporelle utilisée par PL3.
ifr_help: Power Limit 3 Time Window value in Milli seconds. The value may vary from 3 to 64(max).Indicates the time window over which Power Limit 3 value should be maintained. If the value is 0, BIOS leaves the hardware default value

name: Power Limit 3 Duty Cycle
description_fr: Définit le duty cycle associé à PL3, en pourcentage.
ifr_help: Specify the duty cycle in percentage that the CPU is required to maintain over the configured time window. Range is 0-100.

name: Power Limit 3 Lock
description_fr: Verrouille la configuration PL3 jusqu'au prochain reset approprié.
ifr_help: Power Limit 3 Lock. When enabled PL3 configurations are locked during OS. When disabled PL3 configuration can be changed during OS.

name: Power Limit 4 Override
description_fr: Autorise le remplacement de PL4 par une valeur personnalisée.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Power Limit 4 override. If this option is disabled, BIOS will leave the default values for Power Limit 4.

name: Power Limit 4
description_fr: Définit PL4, limite de puissance instantanée, en milliwatts. Variable critique.
ifr_help: Power Limit 4 in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. For 12.50W, enter 12500. If the value is 0, BIOS leaves default value

name: Power Limit 4 Lock
description_fr: Verrouille la configuration PL4.
ifr_help: Power Limit 4 Lock. When enabled PL4 configurations are locked during OS. When disabled PL4 configuration can be changed during OS.

name: Power Limit 4 Boost
description_fr: Définit le boost/complément associé à PL4.
ifr_help: Configure Power Limit 4 Boost in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. For 12.50W, enter 12500. The value 0 means disable.

name: Package Power Limit MSR Lock
description_fr: Verrouille les limites de puissance package dans le MSR PACKAGE_POWER_LIMIT.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable locking of Package Power Limit settings. When enabled, PACKAGE_POWER_LIMIT MSR will be locked and a reset will be required to unlock the register.

name: Platform PL1 Enable
description_fr: Active/désactive la limite Platform PL1.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Platform Power Limit 1 programming. If this option is enabled, it activates the PL1 value to be used by the processor to limit the average power of given time window.

name: Platform PL1 Power
description_fr: Définit Platform PL1 en milliwatts.
ifr_help: Platform Power Limit 1 Power in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. Any value can be programmed between Max and Min Power Limits. For 12.50W, enter 12500. This setting will act as the new PL1 value for the Package RAPL algorithm.

name: Platform PL1 Time Window
description_fr: Définit la fenêtre temporelle de Platform PL1.
ifr_help: Platform Power Limit 1 Time Window value in seconds. The value may vary from 0 to 128. 0 = default values. Indicates the time window over which Platform Processor Base Power (TDP) value should be maintained.

name: Platform PL2 Enable
description_fr: Active/désactive la limite Platform PL2.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Platform Power Limit 2 programming. If this option is disabled, BIOS will program the default values for Platform Power Limit 2.

name: Platform PL2 Power
description_fr: Définit Platform PL2 en milliwatts.
ifr_help: Platform Power Limit 2 Power in Milli Watts. BIOS will round to the nearest 1/8W when programming. Any value can be programmed between Max and Min Power Limits. For 12.50W, enter 12500. This setting will act as the new Max Turbo Power (PL2) value for the Package RAPL algorithm.

name: Energy Efficient P-state
description_fr: Active/désactive les P-states optimisés pour l'efficacité énergétique.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Energy Efficient P-state feature. When set to 0, will disable access to ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BIAS MSR and CPUID Function will read 0 indicating no support for Energy Efficient policy setting. When set to 1 will enable access to ENERGY_PERFORMANCE_BIAS MSR and CPUID Function will read 1 indicating Energy Efficient policy setting is supported.

name: CState Pre-Wake
description_fr: Contrôle le pré-réveil des C-states pour réduire la latence de sortie.
ifr_help: Disable - to 1 to disable the Cstate Pre-Wake

name: C-State Auto Demotion
description_fr: Autorise le CPU à rétrograder automatiquement vers un C-state moins profond.
ifr_help: Configure C-State Auto Demotion

name: C-State Un-demotion
description_fr: Autorise le retour depuis une auto-demotion de C-state.
ifr_help: Configure C-State Un-demotion

name: Package C-State Demotion
description_fr: Contrôle la demotion automatique des C-states au niveau package.
ifr_help: Package C-State Demotion

name: Package C-State Un-demotion
description_fr: Contrôle l'annulation de la demotion des C-states package.
ifr_help: Package C-State Un-demotion

name: Thermal Monitor
description_fr: Active/désactive le mécanisme de surveillance thermique du CPU.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Thermal Monitor

name: Configurable Base Power Boot Mode
description_fr: Choisit le profil de puissance de base configurable appliqué au démarrage.
ifr_help: Assured Power (cTDP) Mode as Nominal/Level1/Level2/Deactivate Base Power (TDP) selection. Deactivate option will set MSR to Nominal and MMIO to Zero.

name: Timed MWAIT
description_fr: Active le comportement MWAIT temporisé utilisé par la gestion d'énergie.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Timed MWAIT Support

name: IO MWAIT Redirection
description_fr: Contrôle la redirection I/O vers MWAIT.
ifr_help: When set, will map IO_read instructions sent to IO registers PMG_IO_BASE_ADDRBASE+offset to MWAIT(offset)

name: Interrupt Redirection Mode Selection
parameters: 0 Fixed Priority (def) · 1 Round robin · 2 Hash Vector · 7 No Change
description_fr: Sélectionne le mode de redirection des interruptions utilisé par la gestion CPU.
ifr_help: Interrupt Redirection Mode Select for Logical Interrupts

name: Package C State Limit
parameters: 0 C0/C1 · 1 C2 · 2 C3 · 3 C6 · 8 C10 · 254 Cpu Default · 255 Auto
description_fr: Fixe la profondeur maximale de C-state autorisée pour le package.
ifr_help: Maximum Package C State Limit Setting. Cpu Default: Leaves to Factory default value.Auto: Initializes to deepest available Package C State Limit.

name: Disable VR Thermal Alert
description_fr: Contrôle la désactivation des alertes thermiques du régulateur de tension (VR). Variable critique.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable VR Thermal Alert

name: PROCHOT Response
description_fr: Contrôle la réponse du processeur au signal PROCHOT. Variable critique de protection thermique.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable PROCHOT Response

name: Overclocking Lock
description_fr: Verrou de la voie overclocking/OC. Le passage à 0 a bien libéré l'OC Lock observé dans MSR 0x194 sur la machine testée.
ifr_help: Observed/tested CpuSetup lock controlling the OC lock state. Clearing it changed the observed MSR 0x194 OC-lock state, but did not clear Undervolt Protection.

name: CPU Run Control
description_fr: Contrôle le support CPU Run Control (débogage/exécution), avec possibilité de laisser la valeur matérielle inchangée.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable CPU Run Control Support; No Change : Comply with HW value

name: CPU Run Control Lock
description_fr: Verrouille la configuration CPU Run Control.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable CPU Run Control Lock

name: Processor Trace OutPut Scheme
description_fr: Sélectionne le format de sortie Intel Processor Trace (Single Range ou ToPA).
ifr_help: Select Single Range Output scheme or ToPA table Output scheme

name: Processor trace
description_fr: Active/désactive Intel Processor Trace ; l'activation lance immédiatement la collecte de trace selon l'IFR.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable processor trace feature from CPU MSR. Enabling this feature will immediately start trace collection.

name: Three Strike Counter
description_fr: Active/désactive le mécanisme CPU Three Strike Counter.
ifr_help: Enable/Disable Three Strike Counter

name: PSYS Slope
description_fr: Calibre la pente de mesure PSYS (puissance système). 0 laisse le matériel/BIOS en automatique.
ifr_help: PSYS Slope defined in 1/100 increments. Range is 0-200. For a 1.25 slope, enter 125. 0 = AUTO.

name: PSYS Offset
description_fr: Calibre l'offset de mesure PSYS ; le signe est défini séparément par PSYS Prefix.
ifr_help: PSYS Offset defined in 1/1000 increments. Range is 0-128000. For an offset of 25.348, enter 25348.

name: PSYS Prefix
description_fr: Sélectionne le signe + ou - de l'offset PSYS.
ifr_help: Sets the offset value as positive or negative.

name: PSYS PMax Power
description_fr: Définit la puissance maximale PSYS communiquée au contrôleur, en pas de 1/8 W ; 0 = automatique.
ifr_help: PSYS PMax power, defined in 1/8 Watt increments. Range 0-8191. For a PMax of 125W, enter 1000. 0 = AUTO.
